comment: Planet presets (stage 1b). Every planet is assumed to be in the habitable zone of its star. axialTilt: degrees between the spin axis and the orbit (0-180; Earth 23.4, Uranus 97.8: it lies on its side, so each pole has decades of day and then of night). yearLength: in Earth years; it changes only the seasons (longer years swing further between summer and winter), the game clock stays in Earth years. starBrightness: sunlight compared with Earth, percent (80-120). eccentricityPerMille: how stretched the orbit is (Earth 17, Mars 93); the planet is closest to its star at the northern winter solstice. water, moisture, relief: the land of the preset; any value can be changed after choosing a preset. Mars is a Mars-like planet in the habitable zone: colder, drier and more mountainous than Earth, not today's Mars.
